detail.longDescription: etcdutl snapshot restore documents --bump-revision ("how much to increase the latest revision after restore") and --mark-compacted . Kubernetes disaster-recovery guides recommend considering them. I understand the general idea: the restored member's revision must be higher than anything previously seen. What I want to know precisely is the failure mechanism: which Kubernetes components actually break (or misbehave) if I skip the bump — kube-apiserver watches? controller-manager informers holding stale resourceVersion s? What are the observable symptoms? Looking for the mechanism, not just "it's recommended".
